description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -Aluthnuwara, Imbulpe D/S Division, Ratnapura District. (25/0238)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations, property ownership, and land titles under the Registration of Title Act. There is no government personnel, organizational structure, commercial, legal/regulatory, or other specialized category content present.
